distinguishing: The back square is tilted at an angle below and to the left of the front starred square (like fanned photo prints or stickers), whereas the other icon has two upright, rectilinear squares offset diagonally (like browser tabs or duplicated items); in practice, the two icons are nearly interchangeable for favorite collections or albums.
